feats.title: Defiant Light
feats.description: You gain resist 5 necrotic and resist 5 radiant. You also gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with runepriest powers against targets that are vulnerable to radiant damage.

feats.title: Rune of Escape [Rune]
feats.description: Whenever an ally within 5 squares of you uses their second wind, that ally can use a free action to shift a number of squares equal to the number of rune feats you have.

feats.title: Rune of Torment [Rune]
feats.description: Whenever an enemy within 5 squares of you fails a saving throw against an effect caused by your runepriest powers, that enemy takes damage equal to the number of rune feats you have.

feats.title: Wrath of Defeat
feats.description: When you drop to 0 hit points or fewer, you can use an immediate interrupt to make a melee basic attack with a +2 bonus to the attack roll.
